item.title: What is atmospheric river hunting? And why is it coming to Portland?
item.description: PORTLAND, Ore. item.title: Bill to fund major renovations at Moda Center passes Oregon Senate
item.description: The Oregon Senate passed a bill Wednesday that would fund up to $600 million in renovations to the Moda Center, using tax dollars from the arena and athletes, in an effort to keep the Portland Trail Blazers in the city.

item.title: Social media threats prompt teacher sickout at Fort Vancouver High School
item.description: Fort Vancouver High School called in an abundance of substitutes and support staff on Wednesday after a wave of teachers called in sick because of threats on social media.

item.title: Gov. Kotek loses out on two previous endorsements as 2026 election looms
item.description: Governor Tina Kotek has lost the backing of two key allies, the Oregon Education Association and the Working Families Party, in the 2026 gubernatorial race, highlighting ongoing tension over state school funding.
